title: A Lewy theorem for harmonic quasiregular mappings in three-space
summary: Lewy's classical theorem asserts that a one-to-one planar harmonic mapping has nonvanishing Jacobian. We prove a three-dimensional bounded-distortion analogue: if \[ f:Ω\subset \mathbb R^3\to \mathbb R^3 \] is nonconstant, sense-preserving, quasiregular, and harmonic componentwise, then \(J_f>0\) throughout \(Ω\). Thus harmonic quasiconformal mappings between domains in three-space are local harmonic diffeomorphisms.
